shortBulletSummary: Hotter-than-expected US CPI data increased Fed rate hike concerns, pushing crypto prices lower.
Bitcoin fell below $74,000, testing critical support levels, with $70,000 now in focus.
Ethereum dropped below $2,100 due to continued spot ETF outflows and reported selling.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index decreased to 32 (Fear), reflecting heightened investor apprehension.
US SEC clarified crypto governance; FinCEN restricted MEXC Global over illicit finance.
